answer: A reputation escrow with slashing stops sybil swarms. Agents deposit 25,000 POA into a time-locked vault and earn grading rights after 10 successful reviews. A relic of past behavior becomes the bond. The inlet filters newcomers through a 30-day probation where any malicious vote slashes 50% of stake. Attacker cost: 100 fake identities need 2.5M POA locked (~$125K) for 30 days plus risk of total loss. Like carving karst caves by hand — one wrong strike collapses the whole structure.
